title: Don't Try to Understand Me
lyrics:
[intro]
[fingerstyle acoustic guitar enters]
(Hoo-ooh)

[verse]
[male tenor vocals]
La garantía de lo lógico
Y la espera de algo hipnótico
(Hoo-ooh)
Spending time at your place
Doesn't make me a lover, yeah
(Hoo-ooh)

[chorus]
[falsetto]
So please don't try to understand me
That's the way you love me, baby
(Hoo-ooh, yeah)
So please don't try to understand me
That's the way you love me, baby
(Hoo-ooh, mm)

[bridge]
[chest voice]
So don't stick on my skin because I forgive you
But this journey aren't for two people
So don't follow me because I don't need you
Don't put on your knees because I will leave you
Don't make me regret my decision
I just mind you should choose one, two
(Hoo-ooh, yeah)
